name: Carlos Renato Hernandez
headline: Senior software engineer — distributed systems, enterprise integrations and AI
shortIntro: I build, integrate and operate the systems that hold a product together: the APIs, the data pipelines, and the operational interfaces on top of them.
biography: I have spent 10+ years building, integrating and operating production software. Most of that work sits between platforms: connecting services, designing reliable backend systems, and turning a messy business workflow into something maintainable. I take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support, and I would rather ship a smaller system that holds than a large one that needs a team to keep it standing.
